rules.accepted_credit_types: Board-approved activities: presentations (in person or audio/audio-visual), vendor home study and computer-based courses, graduate courses (1 credit = 20 h), first-time teaching of academic courses, presenting (1 h = 3 h), developing recorded materials, publications and journal reviews
rules.audit_note: Affidavit of CE compliance at each two-year renewal; monthly random audits; keep documentation 8 years.
rules.notes: At least 4 h on competently serving clients from diverse socioeconomic and cultural backgrounds (Minn. Stat. 148.911(b)). No separate ethics hours found in the rules read. Time-limited variance possible after the renewal date (max 6 months).
